# Message codes: Values

See also: [Message codes](message-codes.md) (the index of every code) and
[Messages and codes](messages.md) (the line grammar, what a code guarantees and
when to trust one).

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_message_reference.py; do not edit. -->

A line shows each value as `<name>` in the catalogue; a line printed by Pitloom
holds the value there. The table lists every name a line or a prefix uses.

## Values

| Value | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `<activity>` | what was running when the signal came: `the build`, `the AI model file copy`, `a guarded activity` |
| `<answered>` | the project name PyPI answered for, as its answer gives it; in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `'<archive>'` | a wheel or sdist by its file name as given, never its directory; in quotes, a URL's credentials masked, cut to 500 characters with `...` before the closing quote, escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<arity>` | how many values argparse expected after the option (`one argument`, `2 arguments`, `at least one argument`) |
| `<author-key>` | the dependency's field the authors were read from: `AUTHOR`, `AUTHOR_EMAIL`, `MAINTAINER`, `MAINTAINER_EMAIL` |
| `<authors>` | a free-text author field as read, on one line, a URL's credentials masked, cut to 120 characters (`...` after it when cut), in quotes, escaped when it holds a control character; several fields as `[a, b, c, ...]`, the first 3 shown |
| `<backend>` | the build backend a pyproject.toml declares in [build-system] build-backend, as written; escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<base-name>` | the SBOM base name used (the file is named <base-name>.spdx3.json), cut to 500 characters (`...` after it when cut); escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<card>` | the kind of card: `model card`, `dataset card`, `Hugging Face dataset card` |
| `<claimant>` | the other element, key or spelling that wants the same id or holds it (a path, a name, `name@version`), as given, a URL's credentials masked; in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<classifiers>` | the `License ::` classifiers, sorted, comma-separated, each on one line, a URL's credentials masked, cut to 120 characters (`...` after it when cut), in quotes, escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<command>` | the git command that was stopped or failed (`clone`, `fetch`, `ls-remote`, `checkout`) |
| `<config-key>` | where the value sits: its table as the file spells it (`[tool.pitloom]`, `[tool:pitloom]` in setup.cfg, `[[tool.pitloom.creator]]`), then its key, the entry of an array counted from 0 and the entry's key, each when there is one (`[tool.pitloom.fragment] files entry 2 role`) |
| `<count>` | the number of files in brackets, `(N files)`, after a space when there are two or more; else nothing |
| `'<dataset>'` | a dataset by the name it was declared under, in quotes, a URL's credentials masked, cut to 500 characters with `...` before the closing quote, escaped when it holds a control character; `None` for a dataset declared without a name |
| `<dataset-field>` | the dataset field as its source names it (`license`, `version`, `general.dataset.0.repo_url`, `rai:dataBiases`, `creator name`), or a dataset metadata field (`byte_size`, `download_url`) |
| `'<dataset-input>'` | a name given in add_output_dataset's input_datasets, in quotes, a URL's credentials masked, cut to 500 characters with `...` before the closing quote, escaped when it holds a control character |
| `'<dataset-source>'` | where a dataset value was read, in quotes: a card or Croissant file as named (`'corpus/README.md'`), a GGUF file as its model's `FILE=` names it (`'demo/m.gguf'`, its path in a wheel or project), `'Hugging Face model card'`, or the dataset's name for a value a library caller set; a URL's credentials masked, cut to 500 characters (then `...`) |
| `'<dataset-spelling>'` | another spelling of the dataset's name read as the same dataset (a Hub id in other case or spacing), in quotes, a URL's credentials masked, cut to 500 characters |
| `<dataset-value-type>` | the type of the value that is not text, as Python names it: `NoneType`, `bool`, `bytes`, `date`, `datetime`, `dict`, `float`, `int`, `list`, `object`, `set`, `str`, `time`, `tuple` |
| `<datetime>` | a date and time in UTC as an SBOM states created (`1970-01-01T00:00:00Z`) |
| `<declared>` | the SHA-256 a source declares, in hex |
| `<declared-in>` | where the dependency is declared: `Poetry`, `optional-dependencies`, `extras_require`, or the setting that lists a requirements file; escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<dependency>` | a dependency as declared (a requirement, a Poetry table), on one line, a URL's credentials masked, cut to 120 characters (`...` after it when cut), in quotes, escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<dependency-count>` | how many dependencies, `1 dependency` or `N dependencies` |
| `<destination>` | where a moved key goes now, as pyproject.toml spells it: `[[tool.pitloom.creation-tool]] name`, `[[tool.pitloom.creator]] email`, `[[tool.pitloom.creator]] name`, `[[tool.pitloom.creator]] type`, `[tool.pitloom.fragment] files`, `[tool.pitloom] extract-file-header and [tool.pitloom.content-type]`, `[tool.pitloom] id-registry`, `[tool.pitloom] sbom-basename`, `[tool.pitloom] update-id-registry` |
| `<digest>` | the SHA-256 an element states, in hex, on one line, a URL's credentials masked, cut to 120 characters (`...` after it when cut), in quotes, escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<dir>` | a directory as Pitloom names it (a temporary directory by its name only, `<checkout>` or `<download>` for a remote source's); in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<discoverer>` | the file discoverer of the project's build backend: `Flit`, `Hatchling`, `PDM`, `Poetry`, `Setuptools` |
| `<dropped>` | what a conflict left out (versions, a lock file, a value), sorted, comma-separated, each on one line, a URL's credentials masked, cut to 120 characters (`...` after it when cut), in quotes, escaped when it holds a control character; a value merged from SBOM fragments that is not a text: an element (`ai_AIPackage <spdx-id> 'name'`), a structure (`Hash(algorithm=..., hashValue='...')`) or a number, not in quotes |
| `<duration>` | the time allowed, in whole seconds (`1 second`, `N seconds`) |
| `<element>` | the SBOM element that holds the value (for a fingerprint that matches nothing, the SBOM's SpdxDocument), by its spdxId, a URL's credentials masked; in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<kind>` | what the element is: `dataset`, `dataset package`, `entity`, `file`, `model` |
| `'<type>'` | an element type as the ID registry file names it, in quotes (`'software_File'`), escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<elements>` | G7 elements, comma-separated, each with where its value is written (`model-architecture (written in ai_typeOfModel)`) or `(not recorded)` |
| `<entities>` | names or keys, comma-separated, each as given, a URL's credentials masked; in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<entity>` | an element's name or ID registry key (a path, a dataset or model name, `name@version`), as given, a URL's credentials masked; in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character, cut to 500 characters (`...` after it when cut) |
| `<entries>` | the unknown keys, sorted, comma-separated, each as the file names it; in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<entry>` | an archive member, a metadata key, a path in a wheel or an installed-metadata directory (`demo-1.0.dist-info`), as the file names it; in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<entry-count>` | how many entries, `1 entry` or `N entries` |
| `<entry-key>` | the key of a dictionary entry (`DictionaryEntry`), on one line, a URL's credentials masked, cut to 120 characters (`...` after it when cut), in quotes, escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<error>` | what the reader or the file system reported, or git's own `fatal:`, `error:` and `remote:` lines joined by semicolons (server text), on one line; in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<exception-type>` | the type of the exception a read raised, never its text: bare for a builtin (`EOFError`), qualified otherwise (`zipfile.BadZipFile`) |
| `<exit-code>` | the exit code of the program run (the build or pipdeptree): negative for a POSIX signal (`-9`), a large number for a Windows status (`3221225786`) |
| `<expected>` | what the value must be: `true or false`; `True or False`; `an integer`; `an integer of at least 1`; `0 (no cap) or an integer of at least 8`; `a string`; `a non-empty string`; `a string or an inline table`; `a table`; `an array`; `an array of tables`; `an array of strings`; `a string or an array of strings`; `one of annotation, both, comment`; `one of full, minimal`; `one of pitloom/1`; `one of always, auto, never`; `one of auto, extension, magika`; `one of agent, organization, person, software-agent`; `a media type type/subtype (image/png)`; `a file name, not a path`; `a plain file name (not a path, not only .spdx3.json)`; `an ISO 8601 date and time`; `a path to a configuration file, or a PitloomConfig`; `a fingerprint (sha256: and 16 to 64 lowercase hex digits)`; `an array of fingerprints`; `a SHA-256 in hex (64 characters)`; `"warn" or "refuse"`; `an SBOM, not empty or white space only`; `a local file, not a URL`; `a local model file, not a Hugging Face model`; `a path (a str or an os.PathLike)`; `a list or tuple of strings`; `a mapping of strings to strings`; `one of audio, categorical, graph, image, noAssertion, numeric, other, sensor, structured, syntactic, text, timeseries, timestamp, video`; `a CreationMetadata`; `a path to an ID registry file, or an IdRegistry`; `a CredentialPolicy` |
| `<expression>` | the SPDX license expression recorded (`Apache-2.0 AND MIT`); escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<extension>` | the file extension recommended for an SBOM's format (`.spdx3.json`) |
| `<extra>` | an extra, or several sorted and comma-separated, each on one line, a URL's credentials masked, cut to 120 characters (`...` after it when cut), in quotes, escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<failure>` | what the operating system reported (`Permission denied`), never the path it names, or what the decoder, reader or build step reported, cut to 500 characters (then `...`); on one line, in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<field>` | the project setting that lists the file (`project.readme`, `tool.setuptools.dynamic.dependencies`, `setup.cfg metadata.long_description`), a licence value's field (`License-Expression`), or a project metadata key or table (`project.version`, `[tool.poetry] 'readme'`); in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<fields>` | the model fields not recorded, or recorded weaker, comma-separated, each with a note in brackets when it has one (`type_of_model`, `properties.tags (kept as raw string)`) |
| `<file>` | a file as Pitloom names it (its path, or a remote document's URL or Hub dataset id); in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<files>` | file names, comma-separated, `and N more` after the last one shown; a name in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<fingerprint>` | `sha256:` and the first hex digits of the SHA-256 of the value as the SBOM writes it: what --accept-url-credential takes |
| `<directories>` | the subdirectories that hold a Python project, comma-separated, `and N more` after the last one shown; a name in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<format>` | the model format (`gguf`) |
| `<formats>` | model formats, comma-separated (`gguf, onnx`) |
| `<given-namespace>` | the namespace a command line or caller gives, a URL's credentials masked; in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<got>` | what was found, by its TOML type (`a string`, `an integer`, `a float`, `a boolean`, `a date-time`, `a date`, `a time`, `an array`, `a table`), `nothing` for a missing key, from a library caller `None` or `a value of type X`; a boolean, a number and a string are shown after the type (a string in quotes, a URL's credentials masked, cut to 40 characters with `...` after it, escaped), never a table or an array, and never a value that may be a credential |
| `<algorithm>` | a digest algorithm as the SPDX 3 vocabulary names it (`sha256`); escaped when it holds a control character |
| `'<holder-type>'` | the SPDX 3 type of the element that already holds the id, in quotes (`'software_Package'`), escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<hosts>` | the hosts Pitloom fetches PyPI files from, comma-separated (`files.pythonhosted.org`) |
| `<part>` | the part of a wheel's identity: `name` or `version` |
| `<input>` | what the path was named as: `config file`, `Croissant document`, `fragments directory`, `ID registry file`, `model file`, `PATH`, `project directory`, `project path`, `pyproject.toml`, `SBOM file`, `sdist archive`, `setup.cfg`, `setup.py`, `target`, `wheel file` |
| `'<install-name>'` | the name a member installs under, separators as `/`, empty and `.` segments dropped; in quotes, a URL's credentials masked, cut to 500 characters with `...` before the closing quote, escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<kept>` | what a conflict kept (a lock file, a version, a value), on one line, a URL's credentials masked, cut to 120 characters (`...` after it when cut), in quotes, escaped when it holds a control character; a value merged from SBOM fragments that is not a text: an element (`ai_AIPackage <spdx-id> 'name'`), a structure (`Hash(algorithm=..., hashValue='...')`) or a number, not in quotes |
| `<key>` | the key naming the input: `FILE`, `DIR`, `FIELD` (a metadata field or table), `DATASET`, `MARKER` or `REQUIREMENT` |
| `<key-reason>` | why the element is keyed by its name, or files by their path as read: `not found`, `outside the project root`, `not a regular file`, `used only by a model with no file`, `not found: declare paths relative to the registry root (id import --project-dir) or run id import from the directory the script ran in`, `the project is outside the registry's root`, `their path is outside the registry's root`, `their path leads outside the archive's project` |
| `<kwargs>` | the file-selection `setup()` keywords a setup.py passes, comma-separated (`packages, package_dir`); `**kwargs` for an unpacked mapping |
| `'<later-member>'` | the later member of the same install name, as the archive stores it, in quotes, a URL's credentials masked, cut to 500 characters with `...` before the closing quote, escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<license>` | a licence value as read, on one line, a URL's credentials masked, cut to 120 characters (`...` after it when cut), in quotes, escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<license-reason>` | why the value is no SPDX license expression: LicenseID's reason (`parse failed: Unexpected 'OR'`, `not found: Acme-Terms`) or Pitloom's (`more than one line`); escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<limit>` | the cap, in its unit |
| `<line>` | the line of a requirements file, counted from 1 as pip counts it (str.splitlines(); a continued line by its first) |
| `<lock-key>` | the lock-file key the line is about: `_meta.pipfile-spec`, `category`, `created-by`, `default`, `default-groups`, `dependencies`, `extra`, `extras`, `groups`, `lock-version`, `marker`, `metadata.lock-version`, `metadata.lock_version`, `name`, `optional-dependencies`, `package`, `packages`, `version` |
| `<lock-value>` | a value as the lock file or the line states it, on one line, a URL's credentials masked, cut to 120 characters (`...` after it when cut), in quotes, escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<sha256>` | the SHA-256 of the bytes read, in hex |
| `'<member>'` | an archive member's name as the archive stores it, in quotes, a URL's credentials masked, cut to 500 characters with `...` before the closing quote, escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<members>` | archive member names, each shown as a member is, comma-separated, at most 10 then `and N more` |
| `<metadata-fields>` | [project] keys, comma-separated (`version, dependencies`) |
| `<minimum-version>` | the oldest release of a library that has what Pitloom needs (`1.29.0`) |
| `'<model>'` | a model by the name it is shown under: one with no file (a Hugging Face model, a library caller's model), or the file name a Python file mentions, in quotes, a URL's credentials masked, cut to 500 characters with `...` before the closing quote, escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<module>` | the Python module Pitloom imports for the step (`h5py`) |
| `<name>` | the input as Pitloom names it (a path, a field, a dataset, the start of a requirement), a `setup()` keyword or a name a file declares; in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<namespace>` | a document namespace IRI, as an ID registry file or an SBOM states it, a URL's credentials masked; in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<why>` | why a text cannot be a document namespace: `must not contain '#'`, `is not an absolute IRI (a scheme is needed, as in https://example.org/ns)`, `has a character an IRI cannot hold`, `holds user information, a secret query value or an access token, or a query nested or encoded too deeply to read` |
| `<new-id>` | the spdxId the element is given instead, a URL's credentials masked; in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<number>` | a whole number: a count, or a length in characters |
| `<oid>` | the SHA-256 the pointer states, in hex |
| `<option>` | a command-line option as the command names it (`--allow-build`, `-o/--output`, `--pretty/--no-pretty`), a positional argument as argparse names it (`command`), a library parameter (`project_metadata`, `BuildOptions.timeout`), or a `[tool.pitloom]` setting by its TOML key (`tool.pitloom.describe-relationship`) |
| `<other>` | the option given before, which the one named first cannot be given with, as argparse names it (`--pretty`) |
| `<other-digest>` | the SHA-256 the other element of that name states, in hex, on one line, a URL's credentials masked, cut to 120 characters (`...` after it when cut), in quotes, escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<outcome>` | what Pitloom kept, and what it did not read or record |
| `<output>` | the last line the program run (the build or pipdeptree) printed that is not blank, each control character a space, a URL credential or a known token masked, cut to 200 characters (then `...`); escaped when it holds a character a terminal would act on; `(no output)` when it printed none |
| `<package>` | a package as the lock file or the declaration names it (a valid distribution name), a URL's credentials masked, cut to 500 characters (`...` after it when cut); escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<part>` | the part of a Keras or HDF5 model that was not read: a root attribute (`model_config`) or a key path in a config (`training_config.optimizer`, `layers[0].config`) |
| `'<path>'` | a path in quotes |
| `<pointer>` | the field of the element that holds the value, as an RFC 6901 JSON pointer into it (`/software_downloadLocation`, `/externalRef/0/locator/0`); for a statement Pitloom writes, on into it (`/statement/metadata/<key>`, `/statement/fields/<field>/note`), or into the comment's provenance line (`/comment/<field>/note`), a part no JSON pointer resolves on the element; in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<process-group>` | the process group of the build (POSIX), which its leftover processes share |
| `<project-paths>` | project paths, each shown as a member is, comma-separated, at most 10 then `and N more` |
| `<project-value>` | the name a project directory's metadata states (an embed with --project-dir), exactly as stated (a value not text as sorted ASCII JSON), never collapsed, in quotes: masked whole (a URL's credentials, a secret-named parameter), cut to 120 characters with `...` before the closing quote, backslashes doubled, white space other than a plain space and control characters escaped; when the two sides would look alike (equal up to the cut, or either not ASCII), each also shows `(from character N: '<rest>')`, N counting characters of the masked value and the rest an ASCII literal. Raw text is compared, so a difference PEP 503 or PEP 440 ignores in the first characters can hide one past the cut |
| `<properties>` | the SBOM properties escaped, sorted and comma-separated, each after the element it belongs to (`dataset name`, `base model description`); a model's own property alone (`name`) |
| `<property>` | a property of an SPDX 3 element as the JSON-LD document names it (`description`, `software_downloadLocation`, `from`) |
| `<provenance-field>` | the field a provenance entry is about, as Pitloom's provenance names it (`byte_size`, `verified_using`) |
| `<cap>` | the cap's name; a setting's name when a setting sets it (`max-model-extract-bytes`) |
| `<x.y>` | the Python version Pitloom runs on, as `3.10`: the grammar a file was read as |
| `<reason>` | what the bound check found: a count the file cannot hold, a malformed ZIP central directory, or a GGUF version or ZIP archive it cannot check |
| `<ref>` | a branch, tag or commit as the URL names it; escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<ref-kind>` | what the URL names: `branch`, `tag`, `commit` |
| `<reference>` | the spdxId a property names (`-` for an empty one), a URL's credentials masked; in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<refusal>` | argparse's reason for refusing the value, on one line (`invalid choice: ...`); never a missing value (`expected ...`) or a conflict (`not allowed with ...`); in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<what>` | what of an element the ID registry cannot hold: `key`, `name`, `project_root`, `sha256`, `spdxId`, `type name` |
| `<requirement>` | Pitloom with the extra that installs the library (`pitloom[gguf]`); `pitloom[ai]` installs every model reader |
| `'<root>'` | the directory a path is checked against (--project-dir, a project root), in quotes like the path beside it |
| `'<sbom-filename>'` | the file name given as --sbom-filename, in quotes, a URL's credentials masked, cut to 500 characters with `...` before the closing quote, escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<sbom-value>` | the value the SBOM states (its subject's name or version, or its type), exactly as stated (a value not text as sorted ASCII JSON), never collapsed, in quotes: masked whole (a URL's credentials, a secret-named parameter), cut to 120 characters with `...` before the closing quote, backslashes doubled, white space other than a plain space and control characters escaped; when the two sides would look alike (equal up to the cut, or either not ASCII), each also shows `(from character N: '<rest>')`, N counting characters of the masked value and the rest an ASCII literal. Raw text is compared, so a difference PEP 503 or PEP 440 ignores in the first characters can hide one past the cut |
| `<setting>` | a configuration setting as the file names it (`accept-url-credentials`, `url-credentials`, the known key an unknown one is closest to) |
| `<settings>` | the build settings left out, comma-separated, as the file names them (`tool.hatch.metadata.hooks`, `tool.setuptools.cmdclass`, `metadata.version`) |
| `<signal>` | the signal that ended Pitloom: `SIGTERM`, `SIGHUP`, `SIGBREAK` |
| `<size>` | a size in bytes (`1 byte`, `N bytes`) |
| `<source>` | what declared a digest (`the PyPI JSON API`) |
| `<source-kind>` | the kind of source that gives no registry version: `archive`, `bzr`, `directory`, `editable`, `file`, `git`, `hg`, `path`, `svn`, `url`, `vcs`, `virtual` |
| `<spdx-id>` | an element's spdxId, as held or read, a URL's credentials masked; in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<steps>` | LicenseID's steps (`separator, version_spelling`), or its category when it took none (`listed_name`); escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<table>` | the configuration table: `[tool.pitloom]` or `[tool:pitloom]` |
| `<tables>` | the configuration tables that know a key, joined by `or`, as the file spells them |
| `<target>` | a URL a redirect or a file points to, the repository a Git page URL names, as given, the Hugging Face model URL a Hub URL is read as, or the Hatchling build target the build hook ran for (`sdist`); in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<unit>` | what the cap counts, singular (`byte`, `entry`, `level`) |
| `<url>` | a URL as given, or the repository URL read from it (a PyPI page URL, a Git URL, a request URL, huggingface_hub's HF_ENDPOINT, or the page of the Hugging Face model or dataset a Hub API request asked about); in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<use>` | what the file was read or written for, or the directory listed for: `for dataset hashing`, `for dependency pins`, `for file discovery`, `for file scanning`, `for ID registry indexing`, `for the input check`, `for license files`, `for the configuration`, `for the project metadata`, `for the Croissant document`, `for the dataset card`, `for the Hugging Face dataset card`, `for the ID registry`, `for the model card`, `for the model hash`, `for the PyPI release metadata`, `for resolving relative paths`, `for the SBOM`, `for the SBOM fragment`, `for the script hash`, `for usage scanning` |
| `<value>` | the value as the file states it (a tensor dimension: its Python repr, cut to 40 characters); in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<type>` | the type of the value the file holds, as Python names it: `bool`, `date`, `datetime`, `dict`, `float`, `int`, `list`, `NoneType`, `str`, `time` |
| `<version>` | a release version as the URL, PyPI or a lock file gives it; in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<wheel-value>` | the value the wheel's METADATA states, exactly as stated (a value not text as sorted ASCII JSON), never collapsed, in quotes: masked whole (a URL's credentials, a secret-named parameter), cut to 120 characters with `...` before the closing quote, backslashes doubled, white space other than a plain space and control characters escaped; when the two sides would look alike (equal up to the cut, or either not ASCII), each also shows `(from character N: '<rest>')`, N counting characters of the masked value and the rest an ASCII literal. Raw text is compared, so a difference PEP 503 or PEP 440 ignores in the first characters can hide one past the cut |
| `<when>` | the case the option has no effect in, or cannot be used in (`without --allow-build`, `for a remote repository (...)`, `when embedding multiple wheels`) |
| `<why>` | why a redirect or an HF_ENDPOINT was refused, a file skipped, a release yanked (`no reason given` when PyPI gives none), or a Git URL could not be checked for a redirect (`HTTP 404`, `no answer in time`, an exception's class name); on one line, in quotes, escaped, when it holds a control character |
| `<command-line>` | a git command line as run, the credentials of a URL in it taken out; escaped when it holds a control character |
| `<skipped>` | how many wheels were skipped |
| `<subcommand>` | the `loom` command that failed (`generate`, `fragment validate`) |
